articles.title_en: Are Bankruptcy Professional Fees Excessively High?
articles.title_cn: 破产专业费用是否过高？
articles.abstract_en: Chapter 7 is the most popular bankruptcy system for U.S. firms and individuals. Chapter 7 professional fees are substantial. Theoretically, high fees might be an unavoidable cost of incentivizing professionals. I test this empirically. I study trustees, the most important professionals in chapter 7, who liquidate assets in exchange for legally mandated commissions. Exploiting kinks in the commission function, I estimate a structural model of moral hazard by trustees. I show that a policy change lowering trustee fees would harm trustee incentives, reducing liquidation values. Nonetheless, such a policy would dramatically improve creditor recovery, increasing small-business-lender recovery by 15.7%.
articles.abstract_cn: 第七章是美国企业和个人最常用的破产制度。第七章的专业费用相当可观。理论上，高费用可能是激励专业人士不可避免的成本。我对此进行了实证检验。我研究了第七章中最重要的专业人士——受托人，他们以法定佣金为代价清算资产。利用佣金函数中的拐点，我估计了一个受托人道德风险的结构模型。我表明，降低受托人费用的政策变化会损害受托人的激励，降低清算价值。尽管如此，这样的政策将显著提高债权人回收率，使小企业贷款人的回收率提高15.7%。

articles.title_en: The Imitation Game: The Imitation Game: How Encouraging Renegotiation Makes Good Borrowers Bad
articles.title_cn: 模仿游戏：鼓励重新谈判如何使好借款人变坏
articles.abstract_en: We show that commercial mortgage borrowers behave opportunistically to attempt to obtain principal reductions. We develop a model in which lenders cannot perfectly observe borrowers’ use values and renegotiation is costly. We then exploit a tax rule change that reduced the cost of renegotiation. Consistent with the model predictions, borrowers with high private use values of the property are more likely to transfer into special servicing when lenders have a higher capacity to negotiate principal reductions after the rule change. Our results suggest adverse consequences of principal forgiveness for lenders.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，商业抵押贷款借款人会机会主义地试图获得本金减免。我们开发了一个模型，其中贷款人无法完美观察借款人的使用价值，且重新谈判成本高昂。然后我们利用一项降低重新谈判成本的税收规则变更。与模型预测一致，当规则变更后贷款人拥有更高的本金减免谈判能力时，具有高私人财产使用价值的借款人更有可能转入特殊服务。我们的结果表明，本金减免对贷款人存在不利后果。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Crisis-Period Interest Rate Declines on Distressed Borrowers
articles.title_cn: 危机时期利率下调对困境借款人的影响
articles.abstract_en: We measure the causal impact of reductions in benchmark interest rates on the renegotiation and performance of distressed loans, using 2000s subprime mortgages as a laboratory. Subprime borrowers treated with larger benchmark rate reductions benefited from increased debt-renegotiation probabilities and lower debt-service payments. Modification rates were similar among current and delinquent borrowers but higher for real estate investors, highlighting the role of financial acumen in renegotiation. Renegotiations also reduced longer-run foreclosures, but treated borrowers who lingered in delinquency offset these benefits. Findings suggest monetary easing can spur debt renegotiation but alone may not lead to longer-run curative outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们以2000笔次级抵押贷款为实验室，衡量基准利率下调对困境贷款重新谈判和表现的因果影响。接受较大基准利率下调的次级借款人受益于更高的债务重新谈判概率和更低的偿债支出。当前借款人和违约借款人的修改率相似，但房地产投资者的修改率更高，凸显了金融知识在重新谈判中的作用。重新谈判也减少了长期止赎，但滞留在违约状态的受处理借款人抵消了这些益处。研究结果表明，货币宽松可以刺激债务重新谈判，但单独可能不会带来长期治愈性结果。

articles.title_en: Student Loans, Access to Credit, and Consumer Credit Demand
articles.title_cn: 学生贷款、信贷获取与消费信贷需求
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides novel evidence that increased student loan debts, caused by rising tuitions, increase borrowers’ demand for additional consumer debt, while simultaneously restricting their ability to access it. The net effect of student loan debt on consumer borrowing varies by market, depending on whether the supply or demand channel dominates. In loosely underwritten credit markets, increased student loan debt causes borrowing to increase, while in tightly underwritten markets, increased student loan debt reduces credit use. These findings match predictions of a standard life cycle model of household consumption and borrowing, augmented by a realistic student loan repayment contract. (JEL G51, D15, I22, D14)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了新的证据，表明由学费上涨导致的学生贷款债务增加，提高了借款人对额外消费债务的需求，同时限制了其获取信贷的能力。学生贷款债务对消费借贷的净效应因市场而异，取决于供给渠道还是需求渠道占主导。在承销标准宽松的信贷市场中，学生贷款债务的增加导致借贷增加，而在承销标准严格的市场中，学生贷款债务的增加减少了信贷使用。这些发现与标准家庭消费和借贷生命周期模型的预测相符，该模型增加了现实的学生贷款还款合同。（JEL G51, D15, I22, D14）

articles.title_en: Syndicated Lending, Competition, and Relative Performance Evaluation
articles.title_cn: 银团贷款、竞争与相对绩效评估
articles.abstract_en: Relative performance evaluation (RPE) intensifies competitive pressure by tying executive compensation to the profits of rivals. We show that these contracts make loan syndication harder by reducing banks’ willingness to participate in loans underwritten by banks named in their RPE contracts. Lead arranger banks, which are more frequently named in RPE, hold larger shares of the loans they syndicate, and their borrowers receive smaller and fewer loans and face higher spreads. Our results highlight the tension between the normal benefits of competition versus the need for cooperation in loan syndication.
articles.abstract_cn: 相对绩效评估（RPE）通过将高管薪酬与竞争对手的利润挂钩，加剧了竞争压力。我们表明，这些合同使得银团贷款更加困难，因为银行参与由其在RPE合同中指定的银行承销的贷款的意愿降低。牵头安排行更频繁地被列入RPE合同，它们在其银团贷款中持有更大的份额，其借款人获得的贷款规模更小、数量更少，且面临更高的利差。我们的结果凸显了竞争的正常收益与银团贷款中合作需求之间的张力。

articles.title_en: Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Bond Advising and Underwriting
articles.title_cn: 市政债券咨询与承销中的利益冲突
articles.abstract_en: When can financial advisor conflicts of interest generate worse outcomes for clients? A regulation following from Dodd-Frank prohibits municipal advisors from simultaneously acting as bond underwriters. Using a difference-in-differences approach and 20,051 bond auctions, I test whether limited advisor privileges affect financial advice and borrower outcomes. Financing costs of bonds with potential dual advisor-underwriters fall by 11.4 basis points after the advisor is no longer allowed to underwrite. The decline follows from increases in standardization, third-party certification, and auction participation, all of which are consistent with limiting the adverse selection that arises from advisors withholding information from the market. (JEL D44, D53, G12, G14, G28, H74)
articles.abstract_cn: 财务顾问的利益冲突何时会给客户带来更差的结果？多德-弗兰克法案后的一项法规禁止市政顾问同时担任债券承销商。利用双重差分方法和20,051次债券拍卖，我检验了有限的顾问特权是否影响财务建议和借款人结果。在顾问不再被允许承销后，具有潜在双重顾问-承销商身份的债券融资成本下降了11.4个基点。这一下降源于标准化、第三方认证和拍卖参与度的提高，所有这些都与限制顾问向市场隐瞒信息所产生的逆向选择相一致。(JEL D44, D53, G12, G14, G28, H74)

articles.title_en: Proxy Advisory Firms and Corporate Shareholder Engagement
articles.title_cn: 代理咨询公司与公司股东参与
articles.abstract_en: We study how Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) affect firms’ engagement with shareholders. Our analyses exploit a quasi-natural experiment using say-on-pay voting outcomes near a threshold that triggers ISS to review engagement activities. Firms receiving ISS treatment exhibit swift and substantive increases in extensive and intensive margins of engagement, especially when their boards have higher agency conflicts and directors are more likely to lose voting support from ISS. Increases in engagement persist over time, and shareholders appear to value the increased engagement. Collectively, we shed light on an unexplored channel through which ISS positively influences firms’ governance and information environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究机构股东服务公司（ISS）如何影响公司与股东的互动。我们的分析利用了一个准自然实验，基于薪酬话语权投票结果接近阈值的情况，该阈值触发ISS审查参与活动。接受ISS处理的公司在其参与的广度和深度上表现出迅速且实质性的增加，尤其是当董事会存在更高的代理冲突且董事更可能失去ISS的投票支持时。参与度的增加随时间持续，股东似乎重视这种增加的参与。总体而言，我们揭示了ISS通过一个未被探索的渠道积极影响公司治理和信息环境。
